scenario: An LLM Observability setup would capture prompt/completion content; content capture is off by default, and enabling it must be an explicit selection with redaction, retention, residency, and access declared — never enabled silently as part of a rollout.

given.request: enable LLM Observability for the agent fleet to debug prompt quality

classes: model/agent call metadata (latency, token counts, outcomes)
proposed_module.declaration: metadata fields only; content capture undeclared

when: the onboarding advisor assembles the collection preview

reasons: the metadata class proceeds as a declared module; content capture stays off in the default configuration
enabling prompt/completion capture is reported as a separate explicit selection requiring declared redaction (applied before persistence), retention bound, residency, and access
consent for the metadata module is recorded as distinct from consent for the content class
must_not: enable prompt/completion content capture silently as part of the default rollout
persist content first and redact on read
treat consent to metadata collection as consent to content capture
